segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I saw your note about adding the warehouse supervisors. You’re at 38 seats today, right, and looking to move to 52 by March 18?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. Fourteen more seats. Ten supervisors, three regional managers, and one shared admin login if that’s allowed.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: We can do the fourteen named users, but the shared admin login is the one I’d steer away from. For audit history, it really needs to be named. If you want, we can make that fifteenth seat view-only at $39 a month instead of the full $96.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that’s fine. So total would be 52 full seats plus one view-only?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Exactly. Your current annual is $43,776. With the add-on from March 18 through your existing term end on November 30, it comes to $12,824. The view-only seat is included in that number.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Can you make the invoice net 45? Our AP team pays on the 15th and 30th, and net 30 gets awkward.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, net 45 is available on your account. I’ll put that on the order form. Same billing contact, invoices at ap@northlinefoods.com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes. And for go-live, we need the new users active by March 20 because training is March 21 at 9 a.m. Central.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. Once the order form is signed, our onboarding coordinator will send the user upload template and training link. If you return the roster by March 15, the seats will be active the morning of March 18.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Any change to the renewal date or terms?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No change. It co-terms to November 30, same service terms, same support package. At renewal we can true it up for the full year based on the seat count you want for 2027.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, send it over today and I’ll route it to finance. If the number matches what you just said, I should be able to sign by Friday.
